title: Inner Lipschitz Geometry of Complex Surface Germs with Non-Isolated Singularities: A Complete Classification
summary: Let $(X,0)$ be a germ of a reduced and irreducible complex surface embedded in $(\mathbb{C}^k,0)$. In this paper, we give a complete invariant of the inner Lipschitz geometry of complex surface germs, extending the result of Birbrair--Neumann--Pichon \cite{BNP} to the non-isolated case. This invariant is expressed in terms of numerical invariants associated with the coordinate functions $f_1,\dots,f_k$ of the normalization map $n:(\overline{X},0)\to (X,0)\subset(\mathbb{C}^k,0)$, together with the combinatorics of a suitable good resolution of $(\overline{X},0)$.
